preprocessing_steps.Description: lowpass filtering, bandpass filtering, notch filtering, rectification, downsampling/upsampling, baseline correction, synchronization

Bandpass.Type: Chebychev type II (EEG lowpass), Elliptic (EMG bandpass), digital (notch)

TaskDescription: [driving_simulation] Participants drove a virtual racing car using steering wheel and gas/brake pedals, tightly following a computer-controlled lead vehicle at 100 km/h. The lead vehicle occasionally decelerated abruptly (20-40s inter-stimulus-interval) to 60-80 km/h, requiring immediate emergency braking. Three blocks of 45 min each with 10-15 min rest between blocks. Trial duration: 3.0s.
Instructions: Drive a virtual racing car using steering wheel and gas/brake pedals, tightly follow the lead vehicle within 20m at 100 km/h. Perform immediate emergency braking when the lead vehicle decelerates abruptly to avoid a crash.
InstitutionalDepartmentName: Machine Learning Group, Department of Computer Science
SubjectArtefactDescription: Impedance kept below eeg: 20 kOhm, emg: 50 kOhm
Description: Emergency braking detection during simulated driving using EEG and EMG to predict driver's braking intention before behavioral response.
